description.en: Wallpaper theming for DeepSeek Harness: bundled 4K photo, your own image or video, paper-anchored palettes, translucency, custom logo, quick chips and named themes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换壁纸与配色：内置 4K 照片、自己的图片或视频、纸面锚点配色、透光、自定义图标、快捷条与命名主题。

description.en: Fresh white-green theme with photo or video wallpapers: the scrim and ink follow the picture so text stays readable, five system papers, paper-anchored colours, one-click presets, a see-through sidebar, brand colours, custom logo, quick chips and exportable themes.
description.zh: 清新白绿皮肤：照片/视频壁纸都能看清字（遮罩与字色跟随画面自适应），五套系统纸色、一键预设、纸面锚点配色、侧栏可完全透明、品牌色与自定义图标、快捷条，主题可保存与导出。
